'''Eeksa's Rare Exotics and Pets''' was a business owned by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Eeksa]] in the city of [[Brindibarr]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]].

During the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Eeksa hired a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to transport an albino [[farlek]] from the store to [[Pelleo Thog]].
